_comment: Advisory IDs we accept and why. The gate fails on any ID not listed here. python: 96 entries, all declined-major or NO-FIX. npm: 3 entries, all NO-FIX and dev-only -- so production npm deps remain strict-zero by construction (nothing shipped is baselined, so any prod advisory is automatically new).

npm.1240981: @fastify/busboy DoS via chokidar (tailwindcss dev chain). NO-FIX: braces 3.0.3 is the latest published and is itself vulnerable (<=3.0.3). Reaches us only through the devDependency chain tailwindcss -> chokidar/fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces and eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces. Not shipped: no production dependency is affected. Clearing it needs tailwindcss 3->4 (declined, PR #184) or an eslint-config-next downgrade inconsistent with next@15.
